He holds a large red and green plastic surprise bag featuring a cartoon Santa Claus and reindeer. Behind him are shelves stocked with various stationery items and price tags. (2) The camera pans slightly to reveal a small boy in a grey patterned long-sleeve shirt standing next to the man. The man points toward a display of similar colorful gift bags on the store shelf. (3) The scene transitions to an indoor home setting. The boy sits on a blue sofa, holding the same red Santa Claus bag. He reaches inside and pulls out a large black paper bag while the man's hands assist him. (4) The boy continues pulling items from the bag, including a notebook with cartoon animals, another smaller notepad, a roll of blue tape, and several pens. The items are spread out on a flat surface in front of them. (5) A woman with long brown hair wearing a white t-shirt appears, sitting on the floor. She holds up the individual stationery items to the camera, pointing at specific details and price tags. The boy remains in the background, interacting with the objects. (6) The woman holds up the original red surprise bag and looks directly at the camera with a smiling expression, concluding the presentation of the unboxed items.
